professionalSummary: Sales Operations Manager with extensive experience administering Salesforce for a 60‑user sales team, managing forecast roll‑ups, building pipeline and conversion dashboards, maintaining quote‑to‑cash processes, and migrating legacy workflow rules to modern automation tools.
experienceHighlights: Administered Salesforce for a 60‑user sales team at Brackenfield Software, configuring page layouts, validation rules, profiles, permission sets, and conducting monthly access reviews.
Ran the Monday forecast call with four regional sales leads, rolling up commit and best‑case figures into the forecast sent to the CFO by noon.
Built pipeline and stage‑conversion dashboards in Salesforce and Tableau used by the leadership team in weekly meetings.
Maintained the quote‑to‑cash link between Salesforce CPQ and the Chargebee billing system, reconciling closed‑won deals against invoices at each month end.
Migrated three legacy workflow rules to Process Builder in 2019 with the help of an external consultant.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Month‑end reconciliation workbook matching 214 closed‑won opportunities to billing invoices, identifying and correcting 6 mismatches.
